source_evidence.quote: Prescribed plants and plant products prepared at a registered establishment must be traced:
The integrity of prescribed plants or plant products prepared at a registered establishment must be ensured while the plants or plant products are at the establishment.

groups.reason: Both provisions address different aspects of the same CP requirement: tracing (movement) and integrity maintenance. They jointly support the single benchmark criterion without being independent cumulative requirements.

rationale_summary: The tracing provisions form a specialization hierarchy, while tracing and integrity provisions support the same criterion.
